title: Claude usage connector (dt-ai-observability-claude, layer 3)
description: Daily import of official Claude usage/cost per developer into bizevents event.type=claude.usage.daily. Set the workflow input org_type (enterprise|console|team) and credential_id (vault entry with the Anthropic key). Enterprise: Analytics API key. Console: Admin API key. Team: CSV importer (this workflow only logs a reminder).

resolve_config.name: resolve_config
resolve_config.description: Build the config from the workflow input (org_type, credential, base URL are input-only); run params may override lookback/dry_run/debug only.

enterprise_analytics.name: enterprise_analytics
enterprise_analytics.description: Claude Enterprise Analytics API: per-user cost + usage for the last 10 days -> claude.usage.daily bizevents.

console_claude_code.name: console_claude_code
console_claude_code.description: Claude Console Admin API: usage_report/claude_code (per user) + usage_report/messages (org-level api) -> bizevents.

team_reminder.name: team_reminder
team_reminder.description: Team plan: no API. Logs the reminder to run csv-import/import_team_spend.py.
